description: Our company SecretWoodStory has been creating handcrafted wood products for our clients all over the world for 10 years. Wooden statues made with soul create a cozy atmosphere in homes in over 100 countries. We carefully select wood such as Oak, Ash, Walnut for each product, so that it is environmentally friendly and transfers energy to each figurine. We have invested the experience gained over all the years of work in each product, it can be seen in every detail of our products. Here you can choose a gift for a lover to accept original gifts or for a lover of wooden art. The quality of our products and the originality of the workmanship will pleasantly surprise you. We are always glad to receive your feedback, they motivate us for new products new products each of your feedback gives motivation to make products better and better, this makes our imagination stronger and more creative. We are always glad to receive Orders from new clients of our company, we are located in a small town in Ukraine, within 3 days we will send you one or several products that you liked anywhere in the world.

Shipping policy

Generally, we will send the items as soon as possible once your payment

affect how quickly your product is inspected.
